Control Objective: Demonstrate commitment to integrity and ethical values
Sample Control Activity: Management establishes and reinforces standards of conduct
Evidence: SOC2-EV-001 — Code of conduct and ethics policy

Sample Control Activity: Security policies are communicated to relevant personnel
Evidence: SOC2-EV-002 — Policy acknowledgments

Control Objective: Identify and analyze risks to achieving objectives
Sample Control Activity: Security risks are documented and assessed using a defined methodology
Evidence: SOC2-EV-003 — Risk register and assessment records

Sample Control Activity: Access to systems is restricted based on approved roles and least privilege
Evidence: SOC2-EV-004 — Access control policy and access review records

Sample Control Activity: User access is approved and updated when roles or employment status changes
Evidence: SOC2-EV-005 — Access requests and approval records

Sample Control Activity: Security events are monitored for suspicious activity
Evidence: SOC2-EV-006 — SIEM alerts and monitoring logs

Sample Control Activity: Detected security events are assessed and investigated
Evidence: SOC2-EV-007 — Incident tickets and investigation records

Sample Control Activity: Changes to systems are authorized tested and documented
Evidence: SOC2-EV-008 — Change tickets and approval records

Sample Control Activity: Third-party risks are assessed and reviewed
Evidence: SOC2-EV-009 — Vendor risk assessments

Sample Control Activity: System capacity and usage are monitored and evaluated to manage capacity demand
Evidence: SOC2-EV-010 — Capacity monitoring and usage reports

Sample Control Activity: Management reviews monitoring results and follows up on identified deficiencies
Evidence: SOC2-EV-011 — Monitoring review and follow-up records

Sample Control Activity: Control deficiencies are documented, assigned, and tracked through remediation
Evidence: SOC2-EV-012 — Deficiency and remediation tracker

Control Objective: Select and develop general control activities over technology
Sample Control Activity: Technical safeguards are configured to support documented security requirements
Evidence: SOC2-EV-013 — Security configuration review records

Control Objective: Deploy control activities through policies and procedures
Sample Control Activity: Security procedures define how relevant control activities are performed
Evidence: SOC2-EV-014 — Approved procedures and review records

Control Objective: Protect and maintain backup and recovery infrastructure
Sample Control Activity: Backups are performed, protected, and monitored to support recovery objectives
Evidence: SOC2-EV-015 — Backup and recovery records

Sample Control Activity: Recovery procedures are tested periodically and results are documented
Evidence: SOC2-EV-016 — Recovery test results and corrective actions

Sample Control Activity: Governance oversight responsibilities are documented and reviewed
Evidence: SOC2-EV-017 — Governance charter and oversight records

Control Objective: Establishes structures, reporting lines, and authorities
Sample Control Activity: Security roles, reporting lines, and delegated authorities are documented
Evidence: SOC2-EV-018 — Organization chart and role matrix

Sample Control Activity: Role requirements and security training are defined and tracked
Evidence: SOC2-EV-019 — Competency matrix and training records

Sample Control Activity: Policy violations and assigned responsibilities are handled through documented processes
Evidence: SOC2-EV-020 — Disciplinary and accountability records

Sample Control Activity: Relevant internal and external security information is identified and used
Evidence: SOC2-EV-021 — Risk and security reporting

Sample Control Activity: Security-relevant information is communicated to external parties when appropriate
Evidence: SOC2-EV-022 — External communication records

Sample Control Activity: Security objectives are defined and aligned to organizational priorities
Evidence: SOC2-EV-023 — Security objectives and review records

Sample Control Activity: Fraud and misuse scenarios are considered in risk assessments
Evidence: SOC2-EV-024 — Risk assessment and fraud scenarios

Sample Control Activity: Significant internal and external changes trigger risk review
Evidence: SOC2-EV-025 — Change impact and risk review records

Control Objective: Manage access through authorization and removal
Sample Control Activity: Access is authorized and removed when no longer required
Evidence: SOC2-EV-026 — Access approvals and deprovisioning records

Control Objective: Implement logical access security measures at system boundaries
Sample Control Activity: Logical access from external networks and system boundaries is restricted and monitored
Evidence: SOC2-EV-027 — Firewall and boundary configuration reviews

Control Objective: Restrict transmission and movement of information
Sample Control Activity: Information transfers are restricted according to classification and authorization
Evidence: SOC2-EV-028 — Data transfer controls and review records

Control Objective: Prevent or detect unauthorized software and malicious code
Sample Control Activity: Malware protection and software controls are deployed and monitored
Evidence: SOC2-EV-029 — Endpoint protection and software control records

Control Objective: Monitor infrastructure and software for vulnerabilities
Sample Control Activity: Vulnerabilities are identified, prioritized, and tracked for remediation
Evidence: SOC2-EV-030 — Vulnerability scans and remediation tracker

Sample Control Activity: Incident response procedures are executed, documented, and escalated
Evidence: SOC2-EV-031 — Incident response tickets and post-incident reviews

Sample Control Activity: Recovery activities are performed, validated, and documented
Evidence: SOC2-EV-032 — Recovery records and validation results

Control Objective: Identify and manage business disruption risks
Sample Control Activity: Business disruption risks are assessed and response plans maintained
Evidence: SOC2-EV-033 — Continuity risk assessment and plans

Sample Control Activity: Confidential information is identified and protected through defined safeguards
Evidence: SOC2-EV-034 — Classification and confidentiality control records

Sample Control Activity: Processing objectives and related requirements are documented for in-scope processing
Evidence: SOC2-EV-035 — Processing requirements and review records

Sample Control Activity: Privacy notice and purposes are documented where personal data processing is in scope
Evidence: SOC2-EV-036 — Privacy notice and processing inventory

Sample Control Activity: Management defines control activities that address risks to objectives
Evidence: SOC2-EV-037 — Control design and approval records

Control Objective: Restrict physical access to facilities and protected information
Sample Control Activity: Physical access to facilities and protected information is authorized, reviewed, and revoked where applicable
Evidence: SOC2-EV-038 — Physical access logs and access reviews

Control Objective: Protect facilities and systems against environmental and physical threats
Sample Control Activity: Physical and environmental safeguards are maintained for in-scope facilities and equipment
Evidence: SOC2-EV-039 — Endpoint protection and software restriction records
